summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) raised thighs intersecting the front skirt instead of displacing it in high_kick, kneel_one and deep_lunge; (2) the skirt occupying the same space as the folded or extended legs in cross_legged and lie_back_elbows; and (3) bulky sleeves visibly merging at the chest in arms_crossed and hug_self. The first two problems are clearly visible at the contact-sheet scale. Disabled cloth physics explains much of the rigid skirt silhouette and missing drape, but the visible leg-through-fabric intersections still need attention. Body proportions and joint volumes generally hold up well, with no obvious tearing, explosions or reversed joints. The sampled clip frames do not establish a definite motion pop; continuous playback would be needed to verify interpolation and foot sliding.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Skirt around the seated hips and thighs, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat retain a broad standing-style flare around the seated thighs rather than settling over them, an expected limitation of the disabled cloth physics that leaves a visibly stiff silhouette.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the folded legs and floor
items.issue: The hem remains tented around the folded legs with little settling against the floor, producing a rigid cloth shape consistent with the absence of simulation.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the skirt, visible in both views
items.issue: The raised thigh emerges through the front skirt surface while the surrounding panel continues below it, creating clear body–cloth penetration despite the expected lack of simulated drape.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Crossed thighs and shins across the lap, visible in both views
items.issue: The crossed legs occupy the front skirt's volume while a large skirt panel remains extended beneath and between them, making the legs appear threaded through the garment rather than covered by displaced fabric.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward thigh and front skirt panel
items.issue: The forward thigh visibly passes through the front skirt panel above the hem instead of pushing the fabric outward, an intersection that remains conspicuous with cloth physics disabled.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Skirt and petticoat above the lifted thigh, clearest in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The lifted thigh crowds the hem while the skirt and petticoat retain a stiff flared shape, with limited fabric accommodation expected from the unsimulated chains.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Hem around the lifted thigh, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The hem stays broadly flared across the lifted thigh rather than folding around it, producing a small rigid-cloth overlap without an obvious loss of body joint volume.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Skirt and petticoat surrounding the tucked knees
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat form a stiff horizontal canopy around the tucked knees instead of compressing into folds, an evident but expected consequence of the disabled cloth simulation.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the skirt, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The raised leg cuts through the front skirt surface while the skirt continues downward behind it, creating a clear fabric penetration rather than merely missing natural drape.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.issue: The two voluminous sleeves merge into a continuous inflated band across the chest, losing a convincing contact boundary and compression folds.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Overlapping sleeves at the center of the chest
items.issue: The sleeves overlap into a broad bowl-like mass at the chest without enough compression or separation to describe the two bent arms convincingly.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Upper thighs and skirt across the lap, visible in both views
items.issue: The extended thighs emerge through the front garment while a large skirt panel hangs between and below them, creating obvious body–cloth intersection that the missing simulation only partly explains.

items.name: run
items.location: Skirt hem around the lifted thighs, clearest in the 3/4 row
items.issue: The lifted legs crowd the skirt opening while the hem retains a stiff flare instead of folding around the thighs, an expected unsimulated-cloth limitation without a definite pop established by these samples.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Skirt and petticoat across the seated thighs and during the rise
items.issue: The skirt remains tented around the seated legs and lifts into a conspicuous rigid arch at frame 65, consistent with driven cloth chains but requiring playback to determine whether the shape change actually pops.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the raised thigh, clearest in the 3/4 row
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds the flared hem without convincing fabric compression, a small unsimulated-cloth artefact with no clear discontinuity between the two adjacent sampled poses.
